artworks.label: Winter wren
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for juniper-mist. One small natural winter wren perched gently on a short weathered juniper twig, soft cool taupe feathers with subtle sage-grey and dusty blue shading, round cream breast, fine feather barbs, tiny dark eye and delicate feet. One small dusty-blue juniper berry and two fine needle clusters on the perch, frosty dew detail, quiet cool diffuse morning light. Fine-art botanical wildlife still-life macro photography, pale mist-sage/blue-grey/cream palette. No terrarium or repeated full sprig; bird is focal subject. Entire subject centered with generous18percent empty margins, clear compact silhouette. Truly transparent background with preserved alpha; no opaque tile, ground plane, frame or collage. Pure illustration: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Never crop/copy/recolour any existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
